3.name: Tools of the Trade
3.notes:
You gain proficiency with Smith's Tools. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of Artisan's Tools of your choice.

Weapon Crafting. When you craft a nonmagical or magic weapon, the amount of time required to craft it is halved.

3.name: Battle Smith Spells
3.notes:
When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Battle Smith Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3rd: Heroism, Shield
5th: Shining Smite, Warding Bond
9th: Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage
13th: Aura of Purity, Fire Shield
17th: Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds

3.name: Battle Ready
3.notes:
Arcane Empowerment. When you attack with a magic weapon, you can use your Intelligence modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls.

Weapon Knowledge. You gain proficiency with Martial weapons. You can use a weapon with which you have proficiency as a Spellcasting Focus for your Artificer spells.

3.name: Steel Defender
3.notes:
You create a Steel Defender companion. It is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys you. It vanishes if you die.

Defender in Combat. The defender acts during your turn. It can move and take its Reaction on its own, but it only takes the Dodge action unless you command it as a Bonus Action. If you are Incapacitated, it acts freely.

Restoring or Replacing the Defender. If it has died within the last hour, you can use a Magic action and expend a spell slot to restore it; it returns after 1 minute with all Hit Points. After a Long Rest, you can create a new one with Smith's Tools; the old one vanishes.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.notes:
You can attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action on your turn.

You can forgo one attack from the Attack action to command your Steel Defender to take its Force-Empowered Rend action.

9.name: Arcane Jolt
9.notes:
When you hit with a magic weapon or your Steel Defender hits a target, you can channel magic to trigger one effect:

Destructive Energy: The target takes an extra 2d6 Force damage.
Restorative Energy: Choose a creature or object within 30 feet of the target; it regains 2d6 Hit Points.

You can use this number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), no more than once per turn. Uses restore after a Long Rest.

15.name: Improved Defender
15.notes:
Improved Jolt. Arcane Jolt's extra damage and healing increase to 4d6.

Improved Deflection. Whenever your Steel Defender uses Deflect Attack, the attacker takes Force damage equal to 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier.
